optimized_sql:
WITH materialized_result AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT item.i_item_id,
           avg(store_sales.ss_quantity) AS agg1,
           avg(store_sales.ss_list_price) AS agg2,
           avg(store_sales.ss_coupon_amt) AS agg3,
           avg(store_sales.ss_sales_price) AS agg4
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN customer_demographics
      ON store_sales.ss_cdemo_sk = customer_demographics.cd_demo_sk
     AND customer_demographics.cd_gender = 'F'
     AND customer_demographics.cd_marital_status = 'W'
     AND customer_demographics.cd_education_status = 'College'
    JOIN date_dim
      ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
     AND date_dim.d_year = 2001
    JOIN item
      ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion
      ON store_sales.ss_promo_sk = promotion.p_promo_sk
     AND (promotion.p_channel_email = 'N' OR promotion.p_channel_event = 'N')
    GROUP BY item.i_item_id
)
SELECT materialized_result.i_item_id,
       materialized_result.agg1,
       materialized_result.agg2,
       materialized_result.agg3,
       materialized_result.agg4
FROM materialized_result
ORDER BY materialized_result.i_item_id
LIMIT 100
